headline: Grants of $525,000, $50,000, and $20,000; proposed CTE admissions and middle school pathway policy changes; and executive session on union contract talks.
summary: The agenda includes three state grants and two proposed policy changes for 2026-2027. It also covers closed-door talks on union and nonunion contracts and several general business requests.
items: Executive session: strategy for successor contract negotiations with Educational Association of Worcester units
Executive session: strategy for negotiations with nonunion personnel, Administrative Clerk Kristi Turgeon
Executive session: review of executive session minutes for August 13, 2026 and September 3, 2026 meetings
Student Advisory Committee items
Donation from Operation Warm of about 500 coats for Norrback Avenue School
Donation from Operation Warm of jackets for about 240 students at Clark Street Community School
Notification of new hire instructional staff, new hire non-instructional staff, and resignations/retirements
Public comment
Superintendent goals for school year 2026-2027 (approve and file)
Creative Experiences Grant from Mass Cultural Council, $50,000 (arts, humanities, and sciences)
Early College Support Grant from DESE, $525,000 (WPS students taking Early College courses)
Early Literacy Consortium Grant from DESE, $20,000 (early literacy teaching and learning)
Prior year payment of $7,900 for missed salary increase
13 prior-year payments totaling $81,975.93
Response to gb 6-23 on current structure at Claremont/Woodland St and proposed changes (approve and file)
Response to gb 6-46 on enrollment and participation of Hispanic/Latinx students in advanced coursework (approve and file)
gb 6-99: Proposed changes to Career Technical Education Admissions Policy for 2026-2027 (refer to Operations and Governance)
gb 6-100: Proposed changes to Middle School Pathway Exploration Policy for 2026-2027 (refer to Operations and Governance)
gb 6-101: Review of suggested National Awareness Days and Months (refer to Administration)
gb 6-102: Annual recognition of May as Mental Health month (approve and file)
gb 6-103: How the district would keep WPS open and operating during a cyber security incident (refer to Administration)
gb 6-104: Evaluation of the School Committee Clerk (approve and file)
location: Esther Howland Chamber, Worcester City Hall; virtual option available via Zoom
